**Direct call sites (the stores created with `createGlobalStore`)**

1. `packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/store/patient-chart-store.ts:19-25`: creates the `patient-chart-global-store` holding patient, visit context and workspace group visit UUID.
2. `packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/store.ts:24`: creates `orderBasketStore` (`'order-basket'`), the order basket shared across the chart.
3. `packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/fe-wrapper/fe-wrapper.component.ts:35`: creates the `'ampath-form-state'` store used by the form entry wrapper.

`packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts:12` defines a local stub of `createGlobalStore` for tests. It would not change with the core behaviour, so it is not affected.

**Code that depends on the exported stores (affected indirectly)**

- `orderBasketStore` is used by `packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts:15,163`, `packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/useOrderBasket.ts:51-56,97`, and the tests `postOrders.test.ts:3,25`, `packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.test.tsx:8,119,134`, and `packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket-action-button/order-basket-action-button.test.tsx:8,36`. Its `_resetOrderBasketStore` (`orders/store.ts:29-31`) also calls `setState`.
- `patientChartStore` is used by `usePatientChartStore` (`patient-chart-store.ts:55-71`, which calls `useStoreWithActions`), and by `setPatientChartWorkspaceGroupVisitUuid` (`patient-chart-store.ts:40-42`). Anything that uses `usePatientChartStore` is affected too, but the references I found only show the store file itself, so I can't list those consumers from here.

The core side is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-state/src/state.ts:61`, which is the real implementation. The `mock.ts`, `mock-jest.ts` and storybook mock in the same repo are not affected.
